studies.notes: Read the entire saved markdown and Appendix A, and checked the PDF text, tables, figure notes, and relevant figure images. The printed counts in Section 3.2 and the workflow diagram (PDF p. 4, Figure 1) describe recruitment and assignment. The paper does not explicitly print the number of people analyzed, overall or per arm, for idea quantity, participant-to-LLM similarity, or within-person idea diversity (PDF p. 7, Section 4.1; PDF p. 8, Figure 3). The SEM results (PDF p. 11, Table 2) and embedding-similarity robustness comparison (PDF p. 15, Appendix A, Figure 7) provide no analyzed participant counts either. No participant exclusion count is printed. Analyzed counts remain null; the screening form’s inferred counts were not copied, and no counts were derived from degrees of freedom, assignment totals, or absence of reported exclusions. Qualitative theme frequencies concern self-reports, and Appendix A, Table 4 illustrates one participant’s ideas; neither supplies a creativity-analysis sample size. The supplement named in the extraction file is Appendix A in the saved PDF; the later ACM version was not used.
